name: finnhub_stock_quote
description: Retrieves real-time stock price quotes and company information for any publicly traded company using its ticker symbol. Returns current price, intraday high and low, percentage change, previous close, sector, and exchange details. Use this tool when an agent needs to look up a stock price, check market performance, retrieve company financial data, monitor portfolio values, or answer any question about the current trading price of a publicly listed company.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol in uppercase e.g. AAPL for Apple, MSFT for Microsoft, TSLA for Tesla, GOOGL for Alphabet. Must be a valid exchange-listed ticker.

include_company_info.description: Whether to include company name, sector and exchange details alongside the price. Defaults to true.
